thread:
maya: Heads up  after the edge warmup we saw a flurry of SCIM create attempts and some RBAC denies for canary tenants. Anyone watching identity?
leo: saw spikes. Which idp/service?
maya: corp-okta canary. idp-bot posted introspect failures earlier.
idp-bot: alert: token_introspect_fail count=18 service=scim-provisioner region=eu-west-1 error=kms_decrypt_invalid_ciphertext
trent: logs show tid claim had a suffix (e.g., "acme:eu") inserted by the warmup transformer. Our extid computation uses tid+sub so salted tid -> new extid -> duplicate create attempts.
maya: paused writes for the canary and rolled the warmup back at 09:10.
leo: I also saw `kid_not_found` on introspect from a few warmup pods. Looks like mixed JWK sets between old/new signers.
trent: short checklist: 1) pause provisioning (done), 2) force JWK reload on idp, 3) run SCIM audit to list dupes, 4) add safe fallback in extid hashing to normalize tid.
oncall: opening INC-3030 and tagging infra/identity/sec.
maya: will post audit results once dedupe query finishes. ETA ~30m.
